title.narrative: Contribution toward achieving the targets of National Strategic Plan for Tuberculosis prevention, care and control in Pakistan - Pakistan (01-Jan-2024-31-Dec-2026)

description.narrative: Pakistan, Tuberculosis, National TB Control Programme Pakistan (NTP)This program has the following goals: To reduce TB mortality rate by 35% in 2026 compared to 2015. The objectives of this program are: To increase the number of notified new TB episodes to at least 520,680 by 2026 and to maintain TB treatment success rate at more than 90% from 2024 onwards. To increase the number of detected and treated of MDR/RR-TB cases from 3,373 in 2021 to at least 8,132 by 2026 and their treatment success rate to at least 80% from 2024 onwards. To increase the proportion of notified TB cases with known HIV status from 52% in 2021 to 95% by 2026 and to treat 100% of identified TB/HIV with ART every year. To improve and enhance TB prevention through i) tuberculosis preventive therapy of, at least, 80% of household contacts and PLHIV with no active TB in 2024 to 2026 and ii) strengthening infection control

title.narrative: Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for PAK-T-NTPP05
Percentage of HIV-positive new and relapse TB patients on ART during TB treatment
Number of people with TB (all forms) notified among prisoners; *includes only those with new and relapse TB

Percentage of notified patients with all forms of TB (i.e., bacteriologically confirmed + clinically diagnosed) contributed by non-national TB program providers- community referrals; *includes only those with new and relapse TB
Number of people with confirmed RR-TB and/or MDR-TB notified
Number of patients with of all forms of TB notified (i.e., bacteriologically confirmed + clinically diagnosed); *includes only those with new and relapse TB
Number of people in contact with TB patients who began preventive therapy
Percentage of people who completed TPT out of those who initiated TB preventive treatment
Contact investigation coverage: Proportion of contacts of people with bacteriologically confirmed TB evaluated for TB among those eligible
Percentage of TB patients with DST result for at least Rifampicin among the total number of notified (new and retreatment) patients during the reporting period

Percentage of notified patients with all forms of TB (i.e., bacteriologically confirmed + clinically diagnosed) contributed by non-national TB program providers- private/non-governmental facilities; *includes only those with new and relapse TB
TBDT-Other 1: Percentage of patients with bacteriologically confirmed TB among new and relapse pulmonary TB cases
Percentage of reporting units which digitally enter and submit data at the reporting unit level using the electronic information system
Percentage of people living with HIV currently enrolled on antiretroviral therapy who started TB preventive treatment (TPT) during the reporting period
Percentage of registered new and relapse TB patients with documented HIV status
Percentage of new and relapse TB patients tested using WHO recommended rapid diagnostic tests at the time of diagnosis
Treatment success rate of RR-TB and/or MDR-TB: Percentage of patients with RR and/or MDR-TB successfully treated
Percentage of people with confirmed RR-TB and/or MDR-TB that began second-line treatment
Percentage of laboratories successfully participating in external quality assurance (EQA) or proficiency testing (PT) schemes
Percentage of molecular diagnostic analyzers achieving at least 85% functionality (ability to test samples) during the reporting period
Percentage of RR/MDR-TB patients with DST results for Fluoroquinolone among the total number of notified RR/MDR-TB patients during the reporting period
Treatment Success Rate in private sector: Percentage of TB patients (all forms) bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, successfully treated in the private sector

Treatment success rate- all forms: Percentage of patients with all forms of TB, bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, successfully treated (cured plus treatment completed) among all TB patients notified during a specified period; *includes only those with new and relapse TB
